content.title: What channel is Michigan vs Arizona basketball today? Time, TV schedule to watch Final Four game
content.text: Updated April 4, 2026, 9:48 p.m. ETFor much of the 2025-26 men's college basketball season, Michigan and Arizona have been two of the best teams in the country.Now, those two overpowering freight trains are headed for a collision. Watch Michigan vs. Arizona basketball live with Sling TVThe Wolverines and Wildcats, both No. 1 seeds, will meet in the 2026 Final Four on Saturday, April 4 at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis in the second of two national semifinal games.The teams have gone a combined 71-5 this season and have largely rolled through the Men's NCAA Tournament to this point, with Michigan and Arizona winning their games by an average of 22.5 and 20.5 points, respectively. It's the kind of dominance that has many believing that their game, and not the national title game on Monday night, will determine who will be this year's NCAA champion.Here's what you need to know to watch Michigan vs. Arizona men's basketball in the 2026 Final Four, including the TV channel, start time and more:What channel is Michigan vs Arizona basketball on today in Final Four?TV channel: TBS/truTVStreaming: NCAA March Madness Live | HBO Max | Sling TVMichigan and Arizona's matchup in the 2026 Final Four will be broadcast on TBS and simulcast on truTV. Ian Eagle (play-by-play), Bill Raftery (analyst) and Grant Hill (analyst) will be on the call while Tracy Wolfson will serve as the sideline reporter.Streaming options for the game include NCAA March Madness Live (with a cable login), HBO Max, which requires a subscription, and Sling TV, which carries TBS and the Turner Sports family of networks.Stream Michigan-Arizona live with Sling TVMichigan-Arizona Final Four start time todayDate: Saturday, April 4Time: 9:19 p.m. ET (approximately)Location:The matchup between the Wolverines and Wildcats is scheduled to tip off at 9:19 p.m. ET following the conclusion of the preceding UConn-Illinois matchup.Michigan vs Arizona picks, predictions, oddsOdds from BetMGM as of Friday, April 3Spread: Michigan (-1.5)Over/under: 157.5 pointsMoneyline: Michigan (-118) | Arizona (-102)Here are predictions for the game from members of USA TODAY Sports' college sports team:Blake Toppmeyer: ArizonaJohn Brice: ArizonaPaul Myerberg: MichiganJordan Mendoza: ArizonaEddie Timanus: ArizonaMatt Glenesk: MichiganJohn Leuzzi: ArizonaBrent Schrotenboer: ArizonaCraig Meyer: MichiganEhsan Kassim: ArizonaOur editors independently choose our recommendations.
